objective: Intake compatible Word passage navigation and faster Marites media upload for Genesis 2.0.5 DEV only; retain all live-impact release holds.

selectionRationale: Existing native module set and private uploader support both changes. Isolate changed paths; reject wholesale MAIN merges and shared-backend writes.
alternativeApproaches: Whole MAIN merge rejected due to Genesis-specific feature and native divergences.
New native compression rejected for existing APK ABI compatibility.
Shared backend migration or isolated paid project rejected by owner.

No shared backend changes, publisher workflow, announcement or release before cumulative parity, signed runtime and verified staging channel.
